bac4ac37a19310357baff3620e535c491a79b4fa.summary: A threat actor naming index published by Microsoft's threat intelligence team. It maps many tracked actor names to their listed origin or threat category and to alternative names used by other vendors. It is a lookup list of actors rather than a threat report about any specific campaign, incident, malware or vulnerability.

ba1dea5cff18fff646a1a4e7aa1344b8fe869fa1.summary: Blog post on whether Scattered Spider and ShinyHunters are one group or two, and whether France arrested the ShinyHunters leader. Google Threat Intelligence Group uses UNC6040 and UNC6240 for related activity, and Mandiant tracks Scattered Spider as UNC3944. The author says a Telegram user claiming to be the ShinyHunters leader answered questions, but could not conclusively authenticate them. The post also covers a reported PowerSchool extortion, a 4 BTC payment linked to LVMH, and an unresolved French arrest. The attribution questions remain open.
